policy: Visually useful source components with unsafe runtime dependencies. Preserve visual behavior + content; rebuild against destination systems.

targets.content_to_preserve: Menu labels, ordering, CTAs (Sign in, Get started)
targets.unsafe_dependency: Old Auth session hook to swap Sign in ↔ Dashboard
targets.reconstruction_approach: Use src/config/public-navigation.ts; Sign in link routes to /login (destination Supabase auth)

targets.content_to_preserve: Column headings, link lists, legal microcopy
targets.unsafe_dependency: Newsletter submits to old Supabase table
targets.reconstruction_approach: Replace newsletter with destination server fn or link to /contact

targets.visual_behavior: 3-field contact form with validation & success state
targets.reconstruction_approach: Zod schema + public API route with rate limit + honeypot

targets.unsafe_dependency: Embeds legacy Calendly link tied to old brand
targets.reconstruction_approach: Update URL; render behind ClientOnly to preserve SSR
